description: Security posture of a public GitHub repository from the OpenSSF Scorecard API: aggregate 0-10 score and rating, every check (Code-Review, Branch-Protection, Dangerous-Workflow, Token-Permissions, Pinned-Dependencies, Signed-Releases, Vulnerabilities, SAST, Fuzzing, Security-Policy, ...) with score, risk level, status and reason, a list of failing important checks, plus GitHub signals: SECURITY.md location, license, archived, stars, last push. Price: $0.02 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/repo-posture

details.description: Include up to 10 raw Scorecard detail lines per check (default false)
